title: India’s CSR spending leaves gaps in health, water security, innovation: Report
description: Non-communicable diseases (NCDs), for instance, account for 60% of deaths in India, up from 45% in 2004-06. Yet, nearly 62% of identifiable NCD funding goes towards cancer, while cardiovascular diseases receive around 12%, despite accounting for over half of NCD deaths, says a study by a City-based global impact consulting firm
